notes: duration_seconds is the generated length (at least 0.5 s, the API minimum); target is the finished length after trimming. kind: how the take is cut. 'tail' = trim the start to the first sound and keep target seconds; 'end-peak' = the loudest point is placed at the very end; 'peak-near-end' = keep the loudest point near the end and record its time.
